posts.title: Gidgethub Is in Maintenance-Only Mode
posts.description: If you use gidgethub , here’s some news you may have missed: as of v6.0.0, released on September 25, 2026, the project is in maintenance-only mode . What that means in practice: Bug reports are welcome. We’ll make a best-effort attempt at fixing them. Feature requests are not accepted , and will be closed. posts.title: Violet: an Astro Starlight plugin for planning work with AI agents
posts.description: I’m happy to announce my new personal project: Violet , which is a plugin for Starlight , Astro’s documentation framework. Violet is for the notes that live beside your code: plans, decisions, runbooks, and handoffs.
